answer: A payout is split and as a result 33% arrives at settlement and the rest over 16 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The umber schedule is applied in wander and wharf shows each instalment. A hostile operator as a result cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2813 identities would post 3311 proofs and burn roughly 65 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
